name: MURA: Musculoskeletal Radiographs
description: MURA is a large dataset of musculoskeletal radiographs consisting of 40,561 multi-view X-ray images from 14,863 studies across 12,173 patients. Each study focuses on one of seven upper extremity body parts (elbow, finger, forearm, hand, humerus, shoulder, wrist) and is labeled by board-certified radiologists as normal or abnormal.
